model: Roboflow/rf-detr-small (transformers RfDetrForObjectDetection), 6 classes, 300 queries, input resized to 512x512 by the image processor
data: public grain detection dataset, tile-level: coco/train (1142 tiles, 19429 boxes) for training, coco/val (362 tiles, 4000 boxes) for model selection; coco/test never used for training or selection
eval: every epoch on coco/val, metric eval_map (torchmetrics mAP@[.5:.95], threshold 0.0); final/ = best-eval checkpoint (epoch 30, eval_map 0.8868)
augmentation_main_run: Albumentations: Perspective(p=0.1), HorizontalFlip(p=0.5), RandomBrightnessContrast(p=0.5), HueSaturationValue(p=0.1); BboxParams coco, clip=True, min_area=25
inference_postprocessing: detkit predict: tile 1500 / overlap 0.2, per-class NMS iou 0.4 + ioma 0.7 across tiles
determinism_note: seeds fixed, but cuDNN/CUDA kernels not forced deterministic (no full_determinism): reruns can differ slightly
